documents.title: Бухарское ханство — договорный переход в вассальную зависимость от России в 1868 году
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology states that the 23 June/5 July 1868 peace treaty made Bukhara a Russian vassal and that territories acquired from Bukhara in 1868–1870 formed the Zeravshan district. Primary treaty/administrative acts still need exact A1/A2 indexing.

documents.notes: Archival inventory/source locator. Specific delo/folios must be opened before using individual assertions as geometry-verified evidence.

documents.title: Заключён Гендемианский мирный договор между Россией и Хивой
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology states two different territorial statuses: Khiva became a Russian vassal, while the khanate's right-bank Amu Darya lands passed directly to Russia. Primary treaty text must be indexed before source-verified promotion.

documents.title: Ферганская область — образование из присоединённого Кокандского ханства
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology identifies the Highest Order of Alexander II by which the territory of the Kokand Khanate entered Russia and was reorganized as Fergana Oblast. Exact PSZRI/archival act number remains to be indexed.
